## How it works

The Service Desk is the **first line** of support. It answers what it can, and passes the rest to the team that runs the service (the **second line**). For external services such as LS AAI, that team can in turn ask the service's own provider (the **third line**). You keep one contact throughout.

## What you can ask about

| Topic | Services |
|---|---|
| Logging in, joining your organisation | [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd), [Perun](perun.qmd) |
| Applying for data | [REMS](rems.qmd), [Discovery](discovery.qmd) |
| Uploading and downloading | [SlideTap](slidetap.qmd), [Data transporter](data-transporter.qmd), [Repository](repository.qmd) |
| Metadata, data preparation, quality checks | [Metadata standard](metadata-standard.qmd) |
| Becoming a contributing partner, collaboration, general questions | — |
| A data breach | Report it straight away |

## Help us help you

Say which service it's about, what you tried, and any error message you saw.
